newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch - Feb 24.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch - Feb 24.

text.p: * Intel Corp and Cisco Systems Inc were down in after-hours trading Friday following a day in which technology stocks led the Nasdaq Index to a 13.09-point decline.
Intel traded at 145-5/8 after closing at 146-3/8. Cisco traded at 58 after closing at 58-3/8.
* PepsiCo Inc was up 1/4 at 34-7/8 in London after the Wall Street Journal reported that the company expected its international business to return to significant profitability in 1998.
* Boston Scientific Corp is expected to report fourth quarter earnings per share of $0.43, up from $0.31 a year ago, according to First Call. Shares closed at 66-3/4 Friday.
* Foster Wheeler Corp is expected to report fourth quarter earnings per share of $0.62, up from $0.56 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 41-1/4.
* American Electric Power Co Inc and Public Service Co of Colorado said they had agreed to jointly acquire Britain's Yorkshire Electricity Group Plc for about $2.4 billion in cash.
American Electric closed at 41-7/8. Public Service of Colorado closed at 38-7/8.

* ReliaStar Financial Corp said it would buy Security-Connecticut Corp for $488 million in stock. It said the deal values Security-Connecticut at $47 per share. ReliaStar closed at 59-1/4. Security-Connecticut closed at 37-1/2.
